assessment_objectives.objective: changes to Control Assurance Automation (CAA) collection or scoring logic that could alter reported control status are detected (e.g., through file integrity monitoring, version control hooks or configuration drift detection).
detected changes to Control Assurance Automation (CAA) collection or scoring logic are reconciled against authorized change records.
changes to Control Assurance Automation (CAA) collection or scoring logic that lack a corresponding authorized change record generate an alert to designated personnel.
the personnel or roles that receive alerts of unauthorized changes to Control Assurance Automation (CAA) logic are defined.

alerts of unauthorized changes to Control Assurance Automation (CAA) logic are investigated and resolved within a defined time period, including determining whether reported control status was affected.
